matches.rationale: Finding 2 identifies that the paper's claim of 'positive weights that sum to 1' in the logits-fusion equation conflicts with how lambda_v^t and lambda_c^t are actually defined (unnormalized sums), which is the same inconsistency flagged in GT1 about the fusion formula contradicting the harmonious-balance claim.
Neither finding discusses the attention reallocation equation (Eq. 5) or causal masking; both findings target different equations (Eqs. 3/6/7 and Eq. 10), so no finding detects this defect.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Raises a plausible but distinct mathematical concern about Eqs. 3/6/7 and normalization of attention weights, which is not the causal-masking defect described in GT2.
Correctly identifies the inconsistency between the claimed 'positive weights summing to 1' in the fusion equation and the actual unnormalized definitions of lambda_v^t/lambda_c^t, matching GT1.
